problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify the real CRTOS CircularAreaWrite ordinary b_force=0 behavior against the unified circular_area_state/store_circular_area resource. Preserve all executable C tokens and original helper-call control flow. The public contract must hide descriptor fields, indices, status, physical backing and operations inside store_circular_area; only caller-owned input bytes remain separate. This run covers only b_force=0; force semantics will be handled by a distinct real-code case.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For null descriptor/input, zero request, or full ring with b_force=0 return ERROR=1 and preserve owned resources. Otherwise write min(requested, capacity-current_length) input bytes to the ring, append exactly that prefix to the logical FIFO, preserve capacity and input ownership, return EOK=0, and produce a state directly consumable by Read/query specs.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require b_force=0 and one abstract circular_area_state via store_circular_area plus caller-owned initialized input buffer. Ensure the same input ownership and either unchanged state on error or an extensional FIFO append state on success. No public implementation witnesses.
spec_hint: Reuse the accepted unified common definitions and Read style: public With should contain state plus legitimate input buffer data/snapshots only. Open the concrete representation only in internal Assertions/helper bridges. Keep exact memcpy byte semantics; do not weaken to emp/shape-only. Ordinary write may truncate to available capacity.
preferred_hidden_properties: The post state uses the same ca_capacity, ca_contents after = ca_contents before ++ firstn actual input bytes, and store_circular_area packages all physical/layout choices.
forbidden_patterns: Do not change executable C tokens; do not expose data_buffer/readidx/writeidx/b_status/physical/operations in the public With; do not use emp/emp memcpy; do not mix force-write conclusions into the b_force=0 contract; do not use QCP_demos_human.
